positions.statement: Taylor says he is seeking re-election to continue work on renovating the Stark Boat Ramp, upgrading Canal Road access and reviewing the land development ordinance.
positions.excerpt: These opportunities include renovation of the Stark Boat Ramp, upgrade access on Canal Road, and a comprehensive review and update of the Rivergrove Land Development Ordnance.

positions.statement: Taylor says continuity of the current council is critical to move city improvements forward.
